name: Acceptance speaker
description: The acceptance run's plain plugin with `avatar.control.all`: its `speak` command sends a short run of mouth levels (the avatar cue API's speech cue) for a bot that is not its own, stamped a second and a half ahead of the clock, and answers with the stamps it sent.

commands.name: speak
commands.description: Sends twelve mouth levels for Alpha, 20 ms apart, the first 1.5 s ahead of the clock; answers with the cue's answer and the stamps.
